title: Two wizards in the Commons with a short visibility distance: one walks out of sight and back, and an exempt landmark stays shown
notes: 6.16: Visibility.Distance is 400 so the Commons is larger than what a wizard sees. The companion backs away until the main wizard loses
sight of it, and its client takes the companion away; walking back, the companion is shown again where it stands. The server names the
Commons' objects exempt from area of interest, which every wizard is shown wherever it stands.
